Maya C: Heads up — we're in a boarding surge for Q2 customers, and I want to lock the QBR runbook + slide owners this week. Renewal risk list also needs an update before exec dry-run.
Samir P: +1. I can take the renewal-risk rollup. Will start a spreadsheet unless someone prefers a doc.
Anika L: I'll own onboarding blockers section and customer success health metrics slide.
Riley K: Can I pair with Anika on the demo flow? I'm in charge of the playbook walkthrough.
Maya C: Perfect. Samir — please capture risk tiers (P0/P1/P2) and add last touchpoint date. Use this template: https://tiny.redwood/qbr-risk-template
Samir P: On it. Quick Q: do we want NPS trends on the exec slide or in backup?
Jasper T: Put high-level NPS change on exec slide, details in backup. Execs want the one-liner + ask.
Anika L: Agree. I'll keep trends to 1 chart and move verbatim feedback into backup.
CS-Bot: Reminder: QBR deck deadline set to 3287720000 per calendar automation.
Maya C: Thanks bot. Suggested owners:
- Exec opener + ask: Maya C
- Onboarding health + blockers: Anika L (+Riley K demo)
- Renewal risk rollup: Samir P
- Customer quotes & impact: Jasper T
- Action item tracker & follow-ups: Riley K
Riley K: I'll own the tracker. Propose a simple table: customer | risk tier | owner | next step | due.
Samir P: That's good. I'll fill rows for the 8 accounts in surge.
Anika L: Blockers I'm seeing: delayed SSO, infra whitelisting, missing data pipeline. Will list with owners and ETA in the slide notes.
Maya C: Can everyone add any high-risk accounts (renewal signal or onboarding > 6 weeks) by EOD Thu?
Jasper T: Added 3 accounts to the sheet already — noted two at P0.
Riley K: Can we schedule a 30-min exec dry-run Fri 11am PT?
Maya C: Friday 11 works for me. Anyone blocked?
Anika L: Free.
Samir P: Free.
Jasper T: I'll be there.
Maya C: Runbook items for the dry-run:
1) One-liner exec ask per account (Maya to summarize)
2) Slide walk: owners present their slides (2m each)
3) Q&A and ask assignment (capture in tracker)
4) Post-dry-run action send (Riley)
Riley K: I'll draft the post-dry-run message template now.
Samir P: I've started populating the risk sheet with last interventions and expected outcomes.
Maya C: If anyone has customer quotes or metrics to show impact, drop them into the "assets" folder in the deck: https://redwood.slides/s/qbr_assets
Jasper T: Pasting one quote here — "Redwood cut our inference costs by 38% and latency is noticeably smoother" — will anonymize for exec.
Anika L: FYI — SSO vendor ETA shifted; I'll add contingency play in backup slide.
Maya C: Awesome. Action items recap (please +ack):
- Samir P: finalize renewal-risk sheet by Thu EOD
- Anika L: onboarding blockers slide + backup contingency
- Riley K: demo flow + action tracker, post-dry-run message
- Jasper T: customer impact quotes + backup metrics
- Maya C: compile exec one-liners & lead dry-run
Samir P: +ack
Anika L: +ack
Riley K: +ack
Jasper T: +ack
Maya C: Thanks all — will send calendar invite for Fri 11 and a pre-read (deck link) tomorrow morning. If anything major pops up, ping me in thread. :rocket:
